label: Ruijie Reyee RG-NBS3100-8GT2SFP
description: Ruijie Reyee RG-NBS3100-8GT2SFP - 10-port Layer 2 cloud-managed switch: 8x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 and 2x 1GE SFP uplinks, with no PoE at all. 20 Gbps switching capacity, 14.88 Mpps, fanless, external 12 V DC adapter, 8 W maximum consumption, 260 mm wide desktop case.
notes: Datasheet: 'Total number of RJ45 ports 8', 'Number of 1GE SFP ports 2', 'Number of 1GE combo ports No' - the uplinks are dedicated cages, not dual-personality ports. No PoE section at all; 'Power supply DC power adapter' (12 V DC, 1.0 A), 'Maximum power consumption 8 W', 'Fanless design', 260 x 120 x 43.6 mm, 1.2 kg. Management is web/cloud only: the datasheet lists SSH 'No', with HTTP/HTTPS login, eWeb, SNMPv1/v2c/v3 and Ruijie Cloud / Reyee App. Layer 2 only - 'IPv4 static route No', 'DHCP server No'; 4094 VLANs, 8000 MAC address entries, 9216-byte jumbo frames. Port names ge1..ge8 / sfp1..sfp2 are the catalogue's naming convention for a web-managed access switch; the datasheet states port counts (8 RJ45, 2 optical), not names.
